# Packaged runtime dependencies

- FusionFix and Ultimate ASI Loader: ThirteenAG and contributors, GPL-3.0. Sources: https://github.com/ThirteenAG/GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix and https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader. The package includes GPL-3.0 and preserves the FusionFix documentation.
- DXVK 3.1.1: Philip Rebohle and contributors, zlib/libpng license. Source: https://github.com/doitsujin/dxvk/tree/v3.1.1. Its x86 D3D9 DLL is packaged as `vulkan.dll`; see the accompanying DXVK license.
- OpenXR loader: Khronos Group and contributors. Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK. The loader license is included with the DLL and package notices.
- Animated Weapons: see the separate Animated Weapons notice and original readme. Its external animation ASI is excluded because GTA4VR controls weapon animation and reloading.

These dependencies retain their respective licenses; GTA4VR's GPL license does not replace their terms.
